head: 4a064b75

failed_checks.check: a Canvas save can build the M8-A ExplorationRevision it appends (LineageBinding and payload_digest) from an accepted host seam
failed_checks.detail: The M8-A API (server/routers/advanced_creative.py) returns no lineage. The M8 spec section 5 defines LineageBinding but names no source for content_basis_digest, creative profile, policy digest or approved master. ContentBasis is built only by scripts/r2/v1_operator.py and fixtures; creative profiles exist only on adaptation branches, which no seam links to an episode; no host seam names an episode's final master. Filling these values client-side would invent architecture.

resolution: ADR-0098 (server-resolved lineage, read-only route) implemented as V2-02e; B3 resumes on the amended executor base.
